nativeContract.parameters: CryptoKemParameters selects the parameter set; CryptoEncapsulation owns independent complete ciphertext and 32-byte shared-secret buffers.
nativeContract.operations: CryptoProvider.encapsulate and decapsulate perform complete native FIPS 203 operations and report CryptoFailure values.
nativeContract.seed: raw-seed is exactly 64 bytes: the 32-byte d followed by the 32-byte z. Native generation and imports retain that seed.
nativeContract.pkcs8: Modern Algorithms section 6.4.6 requires RFC 9935 seed-only [0] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING export. A both import must be checked against native seed expansion; expanded-only imports are unsupported in this profile.
nativeContract.publicValidation: Shared code validates encoded widths and envelopes. Imported public bytes remain owned and their coefficient validation is deferred to native encapsulation.
nativeContract.implicitRejection: Correctly sized altered ciphertext returns the native 32-byte rejection secret. Native input-check failures become OperationError.
